communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: FOIA US Navy record TOPGUN
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Official Military Personnel File (OMPF) for Paul S. Olin
Request following documents;
-copy of history of assignments NAVPERS form 1070/605, Legion of Merit award citations, Meritorious Service medal citations, Navy Commendation medal citations, Navy achievement medal, Air Medal award citations, Joint service commendation medal award citations, Cumulative Record of Training (NAVPERS Form 5300/16), Adminstrative remarks NAVPERS 1070/613, badges, dates of promotions and date of discharge.
Please redact any sensitive personal information per FOIA Exemption 6.
F-18 pilot, Navy TOPGUN United States Navy Strike Fighter Tactics Instructor program (SFTI program)
VETERAN INFORMATION
Name of veteran: Paul Olin
Branch of service: United States Navy
Service: Approx yrs 1991 to 2011
DOB Oct 1, 1969

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Eric Bradley
